scenes.title:
WHO OWNS
THE {yellow:SKIES}?
scenes.subtitle: Top 10 countries by military aircraft
scenes.say: Which country has the most military aircraft? Let's count.
scenes.sayLong: Which countries have the most military aircraft on the planet? Fighters, bombers, helicopters, transports, all of it. Let's count down the top ten.

scenes.name: France
scenes.sayLong: Number ten is France, with 976 military aircraft, led by its home-built Rafale fighter jets.

scenes.name: Turkey
scenes.sayLong: Number nine is Turkey, with 1,083 aircraft, the second biggest air fleet in NATO's European half.

scenes.name: Egypt
scenes.sayLong: Number eight is Egypt, with 1,093 aircraft, the largest air fleet in Africa.

scenes.name: Pakistan
scenes.sayLong: Number seven is Pakistan, with 1,399 aircraft.

scenes.name: Japan
scenes.sayLong: Number six is Japan, with 1,443 aircraft, guarding thousands of kilometres of island coastline.

scenes.name: South Korea
scenes.sayLong: Number five is South Korea, with 1,592 aircraft, always on alert just a few minutes' flight from the border.

scenes.name: India
scenes.sayLong: Number four is India, with 2,229 aircraft, and the gap starts to open up from here.

scenes.name: China
scenes.sayLong: Number three is China, with 3,309 aircraft, and it is building new ones faster than almost anyone.

scenes.name: Russia
scenes.sayLong: Number two is Russia, with 4,292 aircraft.

scenes.name: United States
scenes.say: And number one. The United States, with 13,043. More than the next three combined.
scenes.sayLong: And number one, by a mile, is the United States, with 13,043 aircraft. That is more than Russia, China and India combined.

scenes.sayLong: Here is the full board, side by side.
